title: REQ · Persistent object states survive save, restore and re-entering the room
summary: Secret door object appears when opened and stays open after restore; saves are strictly validated
description: Context: persistence round-trips flags but deserializeState checks only container types, and no secret door object exists in the scene. Desired: a secret-door-open object visible when secret_door_open is true, and strict validation of array and record element types. Expected: door stays open after restore and after leaving and re-entering. Why: persistent world.
acceptance_criteria: Given secret_door_open true, when getSceneView runs, then secret-door-open is present; when false it is absent
Given a saved state with the flag, when deserialized, then the flag remains true
Given a save with non-string inventory items or non-boolean flags, when deserialized, then it throws and readSaved returns null
Given goto_scene away and back, then flags and inventory are unchanged
definition_of_done: Restore and re-entry keep the door open
non_functional: Corrupt saves fall back to a fresh game
